description: Honest obstruction witness for Assumption~genpos / Thm cmono-weakest(iii). Confirms general position cannot be removed.

witness_dom_example.note: R0 dominates (|a_R1|<=0.5<1): sign(Delta)=sigma for BOTH -> 1 bit suffices, yet both are non-margin-monotone (a_R1 != 0). C_mono not minimal here.

witness_nodom_example.note: Without domination the anchor region flips Delta's sign -> two bits necessary (K=2). This is exactly what general position rules out.

conclusion: General position is NECESSARY for minimality (iii): C_dom is a strictly larger, falsifiable, ONE-bit class, contradicting minimality when an E-certifiable dominant region is allowed. The UNCONDITIONAL weakest class therefore remains OPEN; the obstruction is exactly the dominant-region loophole excluded by Assumption~genpos.
